analyzed_vuln.description: The function ndpi_add_connection_as_bittorrent does not properly validate the length of the data being copied into flow->protos.bittorrent.hash, leading to a heap buffer overflow when the provided data is smaller than expected. This is triggered by calling ndpi_int_search_bittorrent_tcp_zero, which can pass an invalid offset or insufficient packet length.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The vulnerability can be triggered when a packet with a payload length less than 20 bytes is processed, specifically when the payload does not contain the expected BitTorrent protocol string, allowing the function to attempt to copy data beyond the allocated buffer.
